meta.name: terraform-module-library
meta.description: Build reusable Terraform modules for AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI infrastructure following infrastructure-as-code best practices. Use when creating infrastructure modules, standardizing cloud provisioning, or implementing reusable IaC components.

copy.tagline: 用代码构建跨云可复用的基础设施模块
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为多云环境编写可复用的Terraform模块。
copy.tagline_en: Build reusable infrastructure modules across clouds with code.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're writing reusable Terraform modules for multi-cloud infrastructure.

howto.what: Claude 会为 AWS、Azure、GCP、OCI 编写可复用的 Terraform 模块,产出 main.tf、variables.tf、outputs.tf、versions.tf、README、examples 与 Terratest 测试文件。
howto.when: 当你要创建可复用的基础设施模块、统一云资源供给方式,或搭建可复用的 IaC 组件时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Terraform 写一个 AWS VPC 模块
say.note: 生成 VPC、子网、网关及变量与输出文件

say.text: 给这个模块的变量加上校验规则和说明
给这个模块写一个 Terratest 测试
say.note: 生成 tests 目录下的 Go 测试文件

howto.what_en: Claude writes reusable Terraform modules for AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI, producing main.tf, variables.tf, outputs.tf, versions.tf, README, examples, and Terratest files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you create reusable infrastructure modules, standardize cloud provisioning, or build reusable IaC components.

say_en.text: Write me a Terraform module for an AWS VPC
say_en.note: Generates VPC, subnets, gateway, variables, outputs

say_en.text: Add validation rules and descriptions to this module's variables
say_en.note: Fills in validation blocks and descriptions in variables.tf

say_en.text: Write a Terratest test for this module
say_en.note: Creates a Go test file under tests/
